text:
Priya Patel: Heads-up: EU marketplace GA is two weeks out. PartnerNag reported intermittent kernel panics when using nvidia-driver 545 + CUDA 12.3 on their managed images. We need a decision: pin matrix for GA, provide interim fixed images, and coordinate the joint announcement timing. cc @Omar Ruiz @Jenna Morales

Omar Ruiz: Agreed we should pin for GA. Proposal (minimal surface):
```
drivers:
  - nvidia-driver: 535.86 (stable)
  - nvidia-driver: 540.30 (compat testing)
cuda:
  - 12.1
  - 11.7
rocm:
  - 5.5
  - 5.6 (opt-in)
policy: "default-to-12.1, allow opt-in 11.7 for legacy; avoid 12.3 until kernel panic root cause fixed"
```

Jenna Morales: We reproduced the panic on our staging fleet with CUDA=12.3 + driver=545 (OOM followed by kernel panic). Root cause looks like a driver-level memory reclaim regression. Hotfix path: revert the memory reclaim heuristic in runtime and ship a micro-driver patch with partner. Working on a hotfix branch, running memory-stress CI. ETA for hotfix build + partner test ~18-24h.

Partners Bot: [automated] Created INF-3350: "EU marketplace GA 7 driver/CUDA/ROCm pin + hotfix coordination" https://jira.example.com/browse/INF-3350. Labels: partnerships, marketplace-eu, driver-hotfix.

Theo Park: PartnerNag's managed images are pinned to driver 545 via their image pipeline; they'll only allow upgrades with a signed change request. Options: (1) We provide a signed hotfix image they can deploy, (2) we enable a runtime shim that avoids the reclaim path, (3) postpone GA announcement by 1 week. Partner prefers option (1) or (2).

Priya Patel: For customer-facing announcement, we need to avoid any GA messaging that implies 12.3 support. Draft schedule:
- T-14d: internal pin confirmed + docs updated
- T-10d: partner image or shim delivered for testing
- T-7d: soft GA (partners only) canary in EU region
- T-0: public GA + joint blog if no regressions

Omar Ruiz: Suggest we add a canary toggle keyed by marketplace-region and partner id. I'll add the rollout toggle and disable auto-upgrades for EU marketplace nodes.

Jenna Morales: Hotfix PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4312. Running partner integration tests now. Test notes: kernel panic avoided with shim enabled; latency +1.5% on p99. Will attach logs to INF-3350.

Partners Bot: [automated] INF-3350 updated: assignees @Jenna Morales, @Omar Ruiz, @Theo Park. Due date: 2024-08-01.

Theo Park: I'll coordinate signed hotfix image with PartnerNag ops and share the package URL in the ticket. Also looping in legal for the partner advisory language.

Priya Patel: Action items: Omar enable canary toggle + freeze EU auto-upgrades; Jenna attach CI logs and confirm perf; Theo deliver hotfix image or shim steps; I'll draft the partner advisory and announcement blackout language. Reconvene tomorrow 09:30 CET if any blocker remains. :white_check_mark:

Omar Ruiz: Adding rollout toggle and protection rule now. Will post a confirmation once the toggle is live.

Jenna Morales: Tests green w/ shim on partner's staging. Uploading artifacts to INF-3350.

Partners Bot: [automated] INF-3350 status -> "in progress".
